    constructor
    · 
      intro h

        intro h₂
        have h₃ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k := by
          rw [Int.ModEq] at h₂
          exact by
            simpa [Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero] using h₂

          have h₆ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
            apply (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hp)).dvd_of_dvd_pow
            exact h₅
          exact h₆
        exact h h₄
      exact h₁
    · 
      intro h
      have h₁ : ¬ ((p : ℤ) ∣ n) := by
        intro h₂
        have h₃ : (n : ℤ) ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
          have h₄ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := h₂
          have h₅ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k := by
            exact dvd_pow h₄ (by
              omega)
          rw [Int.ModEq]
          simpa [Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero] using h₅
        exact h h₃
      exact h₁
  exact h_main

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_not_dvd_iff_pow_not_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hk_bound : k ≤ 4) :
  ¬ ((p : ℤ) ∣ n) ↔ ¬ (n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p]) := by
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp⟩
  rw [Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  have hpow : ((p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ k) ↔ ((p : ℤ) ∣ n) := by
    rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd,
      ← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    rw [Int.cast_pow]
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)
  rw [hpow]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem prime_not_dvd_iff_pow_not_modEq_zero (n : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hk_bound : k ≤ 4) :
  ¬ ((p : ℤ) ∣ n) ↔ ¬ (n ^ k ≡ 0 [ZMOD p]) := by
  constructor
  · intro hn hmod
    apply hn
    apply Int.Prime.dvd_pow' hp
    apply Int.dvd_neg.mp
    simpa only [zero_sub] using hmod.dvd
  · intro hn hmod
    apply hn
    have hbase : n ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mpr (by
      simpa only [zero_sub] using (Int.dvd_neg.mpr hmod))
    simpa [zero_pow hk.ne'] using hbase.pow k
